What shipped: per-rule override select + confirm modal (verbatim .matePairAncestryOverrideWarningText, REQUIRED reason, blank refused with an error notification) inside the collapsed panel; per-tab ancestryOverridesRV, reset when the rules reaching the module change; overridableRules(); the click snapshots the ORIGINAL rules + overrides into ancestryRun beside matchResults and passes overriddenRules (zero-row when inactive); ancestryManifest() built from the run’s own snapshot via .matePairAncestryReport(); the Ancestry tab (guidance / coverage table / Download Audit Manifest = dated MatePairAncestryAuditManifest.csv); status “N block rule(s) overridden on this tab this session: …”; the ONE NEWS.Rmd entry revised in place; REFACTOR shared .emptyAncestryOverrides() and .overridableAncestryRules() with Breeding Groups. New tests: test_matePairAncestryManifest.R (8 blocks / 55) and test_modMatePair_ancestryOverrides.R (14 / 132). Verification (measured): RED audit: all 22 new blocks failed, every failing expectation for the intended cause (Learning 784 method; regexes did not match R’s own “could not find function”); GREEN passed with no test edits; clean regression read (unfiltered, NOT_CRAN=true, load_all() first) 351 files / 8,292 expectations, 0 failed / 0 error after GREEN AND after the REFACTOR (identical); devtools::check() 0 / 0 / 0 both times; lint 0; ratchet 1/1 at ae41927b (3,559,430 B, +10,763 B vs S775 = tests + docs; results 854128e69adc, manifest aa983075d6a2; citation compared at Orient BEFORE the run). Runtime (3E): scratch-installed build + shinytest2, twice (after GREEN and after REFACTOR, identical): 20/5 -> override -> 23/2, 3 overridden rows, 23 x 11 CSV, manifests 1 and 2 (reason, “1 of 4 rules overridden for this run.”, Mate Pair gate text on every row), gate wording in the modal, blank reason refused, late override does not rewrite the displayed run, Clear, 0 console errors; screenshots viewed (the modal itself was caught mid-fade; content verified from the DOM). Disclosures: (1) the first commit was REFUSED by the context-budget hook (SESSION_NOTES.md would cross 25,000 tok); I tightened the stub rather than bypass; (2) my smoke script had three defects (an Ancestry-tab selector that also matched Breeding Groups’, a screenshot overwrite, a hidden-tab DT read) – fixed and re-run, none was a product defect; (3) 6 warning-bearing blocks in the full suite were not investigated (the new files add 0); (4) two known edges left unfixed and untested: a zero-rule table makes the manifest builder stop (Breeding Groups identical), and the select-choices/modal code is still duplicated between the modules; (5) I removed the S769-S773-era records from this file by hand to fit (git holds them; see the end of the file) – the tool-based archive pass is still due. Checklists: lint, NEWS ok; _pkgdown.yml, citation N/A (no export / statistic); article owed in 3b per the plan; a2interactive.Rmd still owed (BACKLOG.md); issue #169 stays open.

Self-assessment (Session 776): 8/10. Strengths: claim first (and the hook’s refusal handled without a bypass); the wording and scope decisions put to the owner with the full text; mechanics (modal mock, download, req class, no-match rule) probed in scratch before pinning; RED 22/22 failing for the right reasons, GREEN first pass; five verification levels repeated after the refactor plus a real-app smoke with screenshots; the live-path divergence surfaced and recorded instead of papered over; scope held (the blank-ancestry read path was filed, not fixed). Weak: (1) the RED fixture followed the script read path, so the live-path counts differed and surfaced only at the smoke (gate (d) applied late – Learning 787); (2) three smoke-script defects cost one rerun; (3) some deeper RED expectations stayed unexercised until GREEN (Learning 784, known). Learnings: 787, 788.

(2) BACKLOG.md pins (measured): mate-pair :8, NEWS sweep :67, blank-ancestry :83, harem-sire :99, slice-5 :119 – grep. (3) Ratchet 1/1 at ae41927b (3,559,430 B, 854128e69adc, manifest aa983075d6a2); compare BEFORE any run, run AFTER committing. (4) Slice 3b traps: e2e numbers come from the LIVE app (blank ancestry -> OTHER: INDIAN-UNKNOWN 0 / INDIAN-OTHER 3, OTHER 2 / UNKNOWN 0), never from testServer(); tab selector scoped to #matePair-moduleContainer; DT lazy render; selectize options; the e2e app runs the INSTALLED package (R CMD INSTALL --library=<scratch>, .libPaths(), NPRC_RUN_E2E=true, helpers in helper-shinytest2.R). (5) Read cap: the hook counts tokens with its own estimator (24,579 tok for 55,795 B) but the Read tool counts ~2.3% more for the same file (one data point: 25,148 vs 24,579), so a whole-file read should truncate near 24,400 hook tokens (an estimate) – keep this file under ~23,000, and wc -c is not the measure. (6) STANDING SET (carried): full-40-char sha + smoke-test gh run filters (sha from git rev-parse); scratchpad/ invisible to git BY OWNER DECISION; renv banner expected; CLAUDE.md warn band (26,360 B) = headroom; zsh traps (no foreground sleep – use a background until loop; no &/disown inside run_in_background; sed -i needs a suffix on macOS; quote echo separators; the cwd resets after cd); trim budget 65,536 B for ALL THREE ledgers; consumers read run SNAPSHOT fields (L780/#150); commented_code_linter fires on a prose comment with an inner # (write “issue 169”); use qcStudbook(minSireAge=, minDamAge=), not minParentAge; the hook refuses a commit that GROWS an over-ceiling budgeted file (do not bypass). (7) 5 untracked render artifacts (Aug 15/25) are known residue.
